note: Contrast pairs in src/components and src/dock that are below WCAG AA TODAY, each pinned to its EXACT measured ratio. This is a RATCHET, not an allowlist, and the entries are DEBT, not approval: any baselined pair whose ratio changes at all — improved or worsened — fails scripts/check-a11y-contrast.mjs, as does any pair that stops occurring, as does any NEW failure. It exists because the lint landed on a tree that already had these; the gate would otherwise have had to be either red on arrival or narrowed until it could not fail, and WORK_PLAN §6.4 exists precisely because the second thing keeps happening here. Re-record with `npm run a11y:contrast:record` after a reviewed change, and keep the note.
